supplementaryEvidence.level: Same-product OL channel guide. Supports interpretation of the matching present primary text; not a substitute for the current official hero/API/client.
supplementaryEvidence.supports: All three values grow only to five; Crossbow leaves the Slash limit infinite. Normal baseline is 1/2/1. Weapon range and independent range additions remain the baseline, including the example QilinBow plus four = nine. Only actual Dodge cancellation of Slash and Nullification cancellation of a trick count as offset. Ordinary Duel/AOE responses and armor immunity do not. Consuming next Draw resets only that item. Multi-point damage is one Jianxuan and another recipient is allowed.

interpretations.rule: Completed nonbasic use and actual offset
interpretations.basis: Primary use-after timing and same-product offset explanation. The edge cases below are general native-use inferences, not a claimed dedicated current FAQ.
interpretations.implementation: Tricks, delayed tricks and equipment qualify after their real use completes. A real Use-type Nullification qualifies even though its accepted-response action is represented as Response. It clears existing units when it actually cancels the preceding effect, then its own completion may grant a new unit. An ineffective ambushed counterspell, armor immunity, ordinary Slash/Dodge response without actual cancellation, or a counterspell against an uncancelable original effect does not clear units. A later counter-counterspell still acts on the preceding Wuxie.

interpretations.basis: Same-product guide expressly distinguishes the actual baseline, infinity and external modifiers.
interpretations.implementation: Each increase contributes one finite native-query unit to exactly one of AttackRange/DrawCount/SlashLimit. The live composed value must be below five. Existing equipment and other source contributions are preserved on reset; unlimited remains unlimited. Durable unit facts retain original source attribution and expire by precise grant identity. Source skill loss alone does not end already issued until-offset effects; death clears that owner's active units.

interpretations.basis: Primary says next Draw phase; the guide states that this item resets after that Draw. Skipped/inserted/replaced and during-phase acquisition details are explicit engine-rule inferences.
interpretations.implementation: Freeze eligible units only at genuine native Draw count freezing, attach them to the exact recorded actual-phase token, and consume only those units on its real completion. Skipped phases consume nothing. A replacement still completes that actual phase and consumes its next-Draw entitlement. A unit gained after a Draw has already begun remains for the next genuine Draw even if the current base had not frozen. Reserved outer-phase units are not reused by nested actual Draw phases. Rule/UI queries remain read-only.

interpretations.basis: Primary subject order, per actual damage semantics, and writer-group numerical example.
interpretations.implementation: One actual positive damage instance opens one optional owner choice. Freeze one living recipient, draw one actual entity, drain all native movement/HP/skill/damage children, then compare that recipient's current hand with all three current recorded values. Equality with any value repeats a one-card draw for that same recipient. There is no artificial four-draw cap when intervening native effects change the hand. Zero actual cards or recipient death stops repetition.

interpretations.basis: Frame-owned native child-return contract and effect resolution, not a separate published FAQ.
interpretations.implementation: The one recipient, original damage/window/source, paid draw sequence and next comparison remain on the owning ProgramSkillFrame. After the first draw has actually paid, source loss/death does not repay or discard the active receipt. Actual descendant damage/dying/recovery follows native typed returns; beneficiary death ends the recursion. No global mutable pending or use-ID sidecar is added.

runtime.ownership: Only frame-owned immutable choice/payment receipts. Numerical units and exact draw reservations are scalar immutable rule facts; the query cache is reconstructed from committed plus current-command history, keyed by count and tail object identity to survive rollback.
runtime.privacy: The original source personally chooses the increment or one recipient through an exact private prompt. Foreign viewers have no such prompt; AI uses the same frozen choices by native AdvanceOneStep.
runtime.events: All new facts enter via AdvanceEventRulesAndQueueFact and native state progression. New event payloads contain only scalars and immutable scalar records, with no collection payload to project.
